purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 19-record item effect batch 015; together these files contain exactly 19 self-contained reviewed records.

items/boots-unending-journey-612.name: Boots of the Unending Journey [Relic]
items/boots-unending-journey-612.effectSummary: While worn by a neutral-good, lawful-neutral, neutral, chaotic-neutral, or neutral-evil creature, the boots grant a continuous +10-foot enhancement bonus to speed. With the relic connection to Fharlanghn, they also provide continuous pass without trace and immunity to fatigue and exhaustion.

items/bow-of-the-wintermoon-607.name: Bow of the Wintermoon [Relic]
items/bow-of-the-wintermoon-607.effectSummary: In the hands of a chaotic-good, neutral-good, or chaotic-neutral wielder, the bow functions as a +1 composite longbow and automatically adjusts its pull so the wielder can add their full Strength bonus to damage. With the relic connection to Corellon Larethian, it also gains the frost and drow bane properties.

items/chain-of-obeisance-620.name: Chain of Obeisance [Relic]
items/chain-of-obeisance-620.effectSummary: For a lawful-evil, neutral-evil, or lawful-neutral wielder, the chain functions as a +1 unholy spiked chain. With the relic connection to Hextor, it can be wielded as a light weapon in a grapple, and a pinned foe must succeed on DC 22 Will or be dominated as dominate monster; only one creature can be dominated at a time.

items/cloak-of-battle.name: Cloak of Battle
items/cloak-of-battle.effectSummary: The cloak grants a +4 armor bonus, can transform on command into a +1 quarterstaff and back, and can make a disarm attempt against an adjacent foe as a standard action using the wielder's base attack bonus and Improved Disarm. On a successful disarm it can fling the weapon up to 10 feet as a free action.

items/contract-of-nepthas.name: Contract of Nepthas
items/contract-of-nepthas.effectSummary: The blank magical contract can be filled with agreed terms. Once signed, any signatory who breaks those terms is cursed with blindness, deafness, and muteness without a saving throw, though spell resistance applies; the curse requires remove curse from at least an 8th-level caster or break enchantment against DC 25, and contracts signed under charm or compulsion are void.

items/dark-heart-of-vollus-780.name: Dark Heart of Vollus
items/dark-heart-of-vollus-780.effectSummary: When implanted in a corporeal psionic undead creature, the dark heart gives it Constitution 18 for manifesting powers and saving throws only, grants +4 on Fortitude saves, and allows Psychometabolism powers that do not require a metabolism. It grants no bonus hit points.

items/demonhair-shirt.name: Demonhair Shirt
items/demonhair-shirt.effectSummary: The shirt grants immunity to fear. A wearer with rage or a similar ability can spend two daily rage uses to enter demonic fury, gaining +6 profane Strength, +2 profane AC, +10 profane speed, and chaotic-aligned natural and wielded weapons for overcoming damage reduction, while taking 2 nonlethal damage each round; afterward the wearer is fatigued for 1 hour.

items/dragonscale-cloak-638.name: Dragonscale Cloak [Relic]
items/dragonscale-cloak-638.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, neutral-evil, or chaotic-neutral wearer, the cloak grants resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire, selectable by command word. With the relic connection to Tiamat, its resistance increases to 20 and it can form dragon wings for up to 2 hours per day, granting fly 60 feet with average maneuverability.

items/driftdisc.name: Driftdisc
items/driftdisc.effectSummary: The 6-foot stone disc carries up to 300 pounds and flies at 30 feet with perfect maneuverability. A spoken command word activates it within voice range, after which that speaker controls it telepathically as a free action from up to 120 feet until deactivated; once per day it can animate as a Large animated object with fly 90 feet and perfect maneuverability.

items/executioners-hood-610.name: Executioner's Hood [Relic]
items/executioners-hood-610.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, neutral-evil, or chaotic-neutral wearer, the hood allows coup de grace attacks as a standard action instead of a full-round action. With the relic connection to Erythnul, each successful coup de grace grants a stacking +1 morale bonus on melee attack and damage rolls plus 1 temporary hit point per level for 5 minutes, up to +5 and 5 temporary hit points per level.
